mintAuthority.summary: IST was minted through Agoric Inter Protocol vault and PSM contracts. Governance approved the protocol wind-down in mid-2025, disabled new minting, and completed the sunset process on June 26, 2025.

controls.label: Inter Protocol vaults + PSM (minter contracts)
controls.capDescription: IST mints only via overcollateralized Inter Protocol vaults or the PSM (1:1 against approved IBC stablecoins), each subject to a governance-set MintLimit; there is no centralized issuer minter.
controls.evidence: Inter Protocol docs describe IST minting through overcollateralized vaults and a Parity Stability Module, each with a governance-set mint limit.

controls.label: BLD stakers + Economic Committee governance
controls.capDescription: BLD stakers approve collateral onboarding and contract upgrades; the elected Economic Committee sets risk parameters and PSM/vault mint limits and can pause contracts in emergencies.
controls.evidence: Inter Protocol governance docs describe two-tier governance: BLD stakers for major changes and collateral onboarding, and an elected Economic Committee with parameter-level control, mint-limit setting, and emergency contract pausing.

review.evidence: Inter Protocol documentation describes IST as a decentralized stablecoin minted via overcollateralized vaults plus a PSM, governed by BLD stakers and an elected Economic Committee that sets parameters, mint limits, and emergency pauses. Agoric is a Cosmos-SDK chain; its governance state is not accessible without a live node or public REST API, and no keyless public endpoint confirmed the current Economic Committee membership or governance contract addresses at the time of review.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Vault + PSM mint mechanism and BLD/Economic-Committee governance confirmed from docs; Agoric chain governance state is not publicly queryable without a node endpoint, blocking on-chain confirmation.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the current Economic Committee member addresses and governance contract state via Agoric REST API (e.g. https://main.api.agoric.net) or a live Agoric node before raising confidence.
